The furnace should turn off
automatically because there is no
redstone signal being applied and then
activate the lever. The furnace should
then turn on. If we turn off the lever,
the furnace turns off again. That's how
you control the furnace with redstone.
Additionally, you can control redstone
itself using the comparator
functionality of the furnace. Simply go
into the furnace's interface and
